Arif Habib Corp
15th October 2020
The General Manager
PakistanStockExchangeLimited
Stock Exchange Building
Stock Exchange Road
Karachi
Dear Sir
Subject:
BOARDMEETING/CLOSEDPERIOD
With reference to the above cited subject, this is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of
Directors of Arif Habib Corporation Limited will be held on Saturday, 24th October 2020 at
11:00 a.m. at Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi to consider and approve the
quarterly financial statements and quarterly consolidated financial statements of the Company
for the quarter ended 30th September 2020.
Further, it is hereby notified that in compliance with clause 5.6.4 of the Rule Book of
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited,Closed Period is hereby determined from 17th October
2020 to 24th October 2020 (both days inclusive) prior to the announcement of results for the
quarterended 30thSeptember 2020.
You may please inform the members of the Exchange accordingly.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,
ManzoorRaza
Company Secretary
ArifHabib CorporationLimited
Registered & Corporate Office: Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road,Karachi - 74000
